endReason: No Units remain in the Host. The campaign ends in defeat.

chronicle.text: The Host is assembled. The road to Middelalderen begins here.
chronicle.heading: The March Begins

chronicle.text: The Host is ready to leave the Starting Clearing.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
The march begins in earnest, the Host trading familiar ground for a road that climbs into stone.
chronicle.heading: Mountain

chronicle.text: The climb is hard enough without adding drama. The high road offers no encounter beyond stone, wind, and tired legs.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The Explore Step is complete. When you are ready, reveal what waits at the end of the road.
chronicle.heading: Arrival Step

chronicle.text: The Host reaches a settlement held by the Nightstone.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Nightstone Rapport changes from Unmet to Hostile.
First Contact roll: 1 + 1 = 2.
Whatever goodwill might have existed dies quickly. The Nightstone make it plain that the Host is not welcome.
The terms are simple, if not generous: 1 Food for the Nightstone.
1 Food changes hands. Whatever the Nightstone think of the Host, the tribute is paid.
The tribute is accepted, but hostility remains. Test 8+ to secure passage.
chronicle.heading: Passage

chronicle.text: Roll: 6, 2, 3 (keep best 2), DRM -1 = 8.
The passage test succeeds.
The tribute and appeal cool the immediate hostility.
Gain 1 Rapport with Nightstone.
A waist-high stone beside the road is carved with debts owed by travelers, lords, and broken hosts. Nightstone collectors claim your march inherits an old obligation from the road itself.
chronicle.heading: The Debt Stone

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: The Debt Stone

choices.label: Challenge the Account (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Leadership and 1 Rapport, then lose 1 Morale. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Settle the Debt (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research or 2 Coin. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Steal the Marked Silver (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 3 Coin. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 2 Coin and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Leadership. Enemy Host: 1C, 2I

chronicle.text: You choose: Challenge the Account.
Challenge the Account: Test 8+
chronicle.heading: The Debt Stone

chronicle.text: You attempted to Challenge the Account, but failed.
Lose 1 Coin.
The Nightstone wardens reject your terms.
The Host pauses after the march. Draw the Camp hand and see what the road has brought with it.
chronicle.heading: Make Camp

chronicle.text: Choose one standard Camp card from the Camp hand, or Work.
chronicle.heading: Choose Camp Action

campOffers.title: Supply Convoy
campOffers.flavor: Coin opens storehouses that pride or haste would leave closed.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:

Provision: Spend 2 Coin to gain 1 Food, Wood, or Stone. You may spend 1 additional Coin to gain 1 additional Food, Wood, or Stone.
Subject to Baggage Train capacity.

- or -
Rest: Gain 1 Morale.

campOffers.title: Raise Local Levies
campOffers.flavor: Not every man who joins the host seeks glory. Some answer because the road has reached their door.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:

Raise Levies: Spend 1 Food. Add 2 Levy to your Host.

- or -
Rest: Gain 1 Morale.

campOffers.title: Host a Common Table
campOffers.flavor: Bread shared in peace can carry a promise farther than a threat ever will.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time, Spend 1 Food.

Choose a Neutral or Friendly tribe and test 6+, applying any Rapport DRM. Leadership may not be spent on this test.

  • Pass: Gain 2 Coins and 1 Leadership, then:
    • If the tribe is Neutral, gain 1 Rapport with that tribe.
    • If the tribe is Friendly, gain 1 additional Leadership instead.
  • Fail: No effect.

campOffers.title: Work
campOffers.flavor: While the road waits, the Host takes up the work at hand: hauling, mending, tending, building, and drilling for what comes next.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:
  • Gain 2 Coin.
  • Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.
  • Repair Baggage: Spend 1 Wood to repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space.

If you have Camp Steward: After resolving your normal Work option, you may also choose 1:
  • Spend 1 Coin to collect 1 Resource matching the adjacent Terrain.
  • Buy 1 Resource from the Market for 1 Coin less than its current Buy value (minimum 1 Coin).

chronicle.text: The Host turns its attention to Work.
While the road waits, the Host takes up the work at hand: hauling, mending, tending, building, and drilling for what comes next.
chronicle.heading: Work

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Choose Work result
chronicle.heading: Work

choices.label: Repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space — Spend 1 Wood
choices.detail: Unavailable: there are no damaged Baggage Train spaces to repair. Spend 1 Wood. Repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space.

chronicle.text: You choose: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.
Gain 1 Coin.
Gain 1 Leadership.
The Host is ready to continue the march.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
The road spills onto broad plains where every distant movement looks important for a moment.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: A trade caravan offers exotic wares... for a price.
chronicle.heading: Trade Caravan

chronicle.text: Trade with the caravan?
chronicle.heading: Trade Caravan

chronicle.text: You choose: Pass.
Sun-marked banners and watchful faces announce Sun-Touched ground before the Host reaches the first buildings.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Sun-Touched Rapport changes from Unmet to Neutral.
First Contact roll: 3 + 3 = 6.
The Sun-Touched receive the Host warily, but without open hostility.
Passage has a price. The Sun-Touched require 1 Stone before the Host proceeds.
1 Stone changes hands. Whatever the Sun-Touched think of the Host, the tribute is paid.
A hungry settlement watches your column pass. Their wardens have stores hidden, but not enough for everyone through the season. What you take or give here will be remembered.
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

choices.label: Offer Relief (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Food and 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Food.

choices.label: Share the Burden (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Morale and 1 Food. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Take the Stores (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 2 Food. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 2 Food and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 2A, 1I, 3L

chronicle.text: You choose: Share the Burden.
Share the Burden: Test 9+
chronicle.heading: Last Grain Before Frost

chronicle.text: Roll: 2, 2, 1 (keep best 2) = 4.
You attempted to Share the Burden, but failed.
Lose 1 Coin.
The Sun-Touched refuse your terms.
The Host pauses after the march. Draw the Camp hand and see what the road has brought with it.
chronicle.heading: Make Camp

chronicle.text: A muddy ring forms at the edge of camp. Coins flash, voices rise, and the Host looks to you: will one of your own step forward?
chronicle.heading: A Wager of Flesh

chronicle.text: Advance 1 Time.
Send in a fighter or refuse?
chronicle.heading: A Wager of Flesh

choices.label: Send in a Fighter
choices.detail: Unavailable: requires an Archer, Cavalry, Infantry, Mercenary, or Hedge Knight in the Host. Choose 1 Archer, Cavalry, Infantry, Mercenary, or Hedge Knight, then roll 1d6. 1: lose that Unit; 2–3: lose 1 Morale; 4–5: gain 2 Coin; 6: gain 3 Coin and 1 Morale.

chronicle.text: You choose: Refuse the Challenge.
Lose 1 Morale.
Choose one standard Camp card from the Camp hand, or Work.
chronicle.heading: Choose Camp Action

campOffers.title: Commission Study
campOffers.flavor: Silver spent on quiet study often returns in louder ways.
campOffers.effect: Advance 2 Time, Spend 1 Coin and Gain 1 Research token.

campOffers.title: Drill the Host
campOffers.flavor: A host that trains in earnest soon learns what kind of war it means to fight.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time, Spend 1 Leadership.

Choose 1:
  • You may immediately purchase either the top card of the Advancement deck or 1 Armor Development from the R&R Offer. It costs 1 less Research Token, to a minimum of 1. You must still pay all other printed costs.
  • Gain 1 Research. You may discard the top Tactics card for free and reveal the next one, though you may not purchase it during this phase.

The Host is ready to continue the march.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Open country stretches ahead, generous with distance and stingy with shelter.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: A company of battle-worn knights seeks shelter. They claim to be the last of their order.

chronicle.text: Choose how many Hedge Knights to recruit
